home.eyebrow: Bureau of Indian Standards knowledge platform
home.headline: STANDARDIZE
home.subheadline: Every Indian standard, certification route and testing requirement — explained plainly, answered from the source.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search a standard, product or certification

trust.grounded: Every AI answer is generated only from indexed standards, and shows the sources it used.
trust.languages: Available in eight Indian languages, including Hindi and Tamil.
trust.independent: Independent of the Bureau of Indian Standards — always confirm against the official record.

standards.title: Find the standard that applies
standards.body: Search by product, sector or standard number and see scope, status and revision history at a glance.

certification.title: Understand the certification route
certification.body: ISI mark, hallmarking, registration schemes — the steps, documents and costs, in order.

testing.title: Locate a recognised laboratory
testing.body: Search BIS-recognised testing facilities by pincode, sector and the test you actually need.

ai.title: Ask, and get a cited answer
ai.body: The assistant answers only from indexed standards and shows its sources. When the source is not there, it says so.

audience.title: Built for both sides of a standard

organization.title: For manufacturers and organisations
organization.body: Track the standards that apply to your products, follow certification progress, and generate compliance handbooks for your team.

individual.title: For consumers and professionals
individual.body: Check whether a product is certified, understand hallmarking, and learn what a standard actually guarantees.

closing.title: Standards should not be hard to read
closing.body: MANAK indexes the published record and answers from it — with citations, in your language.
